Andy Burnham is pushing for education reform to help 'NEETs' find work. The article highlights a local project in Bolton that successfully helps young people gain skills and confidence.

The Poison:
The reliance on volunteer-led grassroots projects to solve systemic unemployment risks burning out the very people who provide the most value.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is in the HOW plane; the government focuses on top-down reform, while the solution is clearly bottom-up community integration.

Social Physics Analysis:
By valuing the 'hard hat' alongside the 'graduation cap,' the initiative attempts to shift the social narrative from elitism to practical empowerment. It succeeds when it integrates community-led pathways.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace. The alignment of local action and national policy creates stability.

The Unavoidable Truth: Qualifications are not the only path to a meaningful life.

The Unavoidable Lie: Top-down education reform alone will solve youth unemployment.
